args.title: Use assertive aria-live and persistent visibility for error toasts
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Change the toast component so that error messages use aria-live="assertive" instead of "polite" to ensure immediate announcement. Also, make error toasts remain visible until dismissed instead of auto-disappearing after five seconds, to differentiate from success messages.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The toast component always uses aria-live="polite" which delays error announcements, and all toasts disappear after five seconds. Changing src/components/Toast.tsx to use assertive aria-live for errors and keep them visible until dismissed addresses this.
